newsitem.title: USA: Promus Hotel in 50-50 development venture.
newsitem.headline: Promus Hotel in 50-50 development venture.

text.p: Promus Hotel Corp said it signed a five-year agreement with Vistana Development Ltd to jointly acquire, develop, manage and market vacation ownership resorts in North America under the Promus name.
Terms of the agreement, a 50-50 joint venture, were not disclosed.
Vistana is privately held and based in Orlando, Fla.

Under the agreement, Vistana will serve as the venture's managing partner and project developer and will market the venture's timeshare units, Promus said. Promus will serve as franchisor and manager of the joint venture properties, it added.

Promus will continue to manage and franchise its three existing Embassy Vacation Resort properties with Signature Resorts, but as a result of the agreement will not develop any properties with Signature, it said.
"Anything we develop going forward will be done on a 50-50 basis with Vistana," a Promus spokesman said.
Signature shares were down 1/2 to 32, although analysts called the movement inconsequential and said it probably was not on the Promus announcement.
Promus and Vistana also agreed as part of their venture that Promus will franchise two Vistana projects now in development.
Those properties will be run as an Embassy Vacation resort in Myrtle Beach, S.C., and as a Hampton Vacation Resort in Kissimmee, Florida, Promus said.
Promus, based in Memphis, Tenn., is a hotel franchisor and operator of the Hampton Inn and other hotel brands.
Vistana owns three resorts in Florida with a total of 1,378 units.
